description: State Rebates for Alternative Fuel Vehicles is a dataset listed in State of Delaware open data portal (data.delaware.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Delaware. A listing of rebates paid to persons and companies for purchase or lease of alternative fuel vehicles. Coverage: Delaware. The portal files it under the category Energy and Environment. Its tags are vehicle, hybrid, environment, energy, electric. The table has 11 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Natural Resources and Environmental Control. The portal shows 2026-04-21 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-delaware-gov-portal.
